name: ReserveWhenOccupied
description: RESERVE is accepted in OCCUPIED and overwrites the parcel owner.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; ENABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'OCCUPIED', actual 'RESERVED'; retrieval_code: expected 'P-C1', actual None

name: DepositInMaintenance
description: DEPOSIT is accepted in MAINTENANCE.
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'MAINTENANCE', actual 'OCCUPIED'; customer_id: expected None, actual 'C1'; reservation_code: expected None, actual 'R-C1'; retrieval_code: expected None, actual 'P-C1'

name: RetrieveWithoutAuth
description: RETRIEVE ignores the retrieval code.
example_killing_sequence: CANCEL ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; DISABLE ; ENABLE ; RESERVE(C2) ; CANCEL ; DEPOSIT(code='') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='') ; RETRIEVE(code='') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C2) ; DEPOSIT(code='P-C1') ; DISABLE
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'OCCUPIED', actual 'AVAILABLE'; customer_id: expected 'C1', actual None; reservation_code: expected 'R-C1', actual None; retrieval_code: expected 'P-C1', actual None

name: EarlyExpire
description: EXPIRE succeeds although expired=False.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C2) ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; RESERVE(C2) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; DISABLE ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; ENABLE ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'RESERVED', actual 'AVAILABLE'; customer_id: expected 'C2', actual None; reservation_code: expected 'R-C2', actual None

name: CancelWhenOccupied
description: CANCEL is accepted in OCCUPIED (parcel is silently dropped).
example_killing_sequence: INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; RESERVE(C2) ; CANCEL ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; RETRIEVE(code='') ; DISABLE ; ENABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; RESERVE(C2) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C2') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; CANCEL ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C2') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'OCCUPIED', actual 'AVAILABLE'; customer_id: expected 'C2', actual None; reservation_code: expected 'R-C2', actual None; retrieval_code: expected 'P-C2', actual None

name: DisableWhenReserved
description: DISABLE is accepted in RESERVED (booking data kept in MAINTENANCE).
example_killing_sequence: CANCEL ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; DISABLE ; ENABLE ; RESERVE(C2) ; CANCEL ; DEPOSIT(code='') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='') ; RETRIEVE(code='') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C2) ; DEPOSIT(code='P-C1') ; DISABLE
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'RESERVED', actual 'MAINTENANCE' | [invariant_violation] I1 MAINTENANCE must hold no customer/credential data, got 'C2'/'R-C2'/None

name: DepositIgnoresCode
description: DEPOSIT accepts any reservation code.
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'RESERVED', actual 'OCCUPIED'; retrieval_code: expected None, actual 'P-C2'

name: ExpireWhenOccupied
description: EXPIRE with expired=True is accepted in OCCUPIED.
example_killing_sequence: EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DEPOSIT(code='') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; DEPOSIT(code='WRONG') ; DEPOSIT(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='P-C1') ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='R-C1') ; CANCEL ; DEPOSIT(code='')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [result_mismatch] accepted: expected False, actual True | [state_mismatch] state: expected 'OCCUPIED', actual 'AVAILABLE'; customer_id: expected 'C1', actual None; reservation_code: expected 'R-C1', actual None; retrieval_code: expected 'P-C1', actual None

name: StaleRetrievalCode
description: Retrieval code is retained after a successful retrieval.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; ENABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] retrieval_code: expected None, actual 'P-C1' | [invariant_violation] I1 AVAILABLE must hold no customer/credential data, got None/None/'P-C1'

name: StaleCustomerAfterRetrieve
description: Customer ID is retained after a successful retrieval.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; ENABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] customer_id: expected None, actual 'C1' | [invariant_violation] I1 AVAILABLE must hold no customer/credential data, got 'C1'/None/None

name: ExpireKeepsCustomer
description: Customer ID is retained after a successful expiry.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C2) ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; RESERVE(C2) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; DISABLE ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; ENABLE ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] customer_id: expected None, actual 'C2' | [invariant_violation] I1 AVAILABLE must hold no customer/credential data, got 'C2'/None/None

name: BadDepositWipesCode
description: A deposit with a wrong code erases the stored reservation code.
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] reservation_code: expected 'R-C2', actual None | [invariant_violation] I2 RESERVED needs reservation_code == R-<customer>, got None | [reject_mutated_state] rejected op changed SUT state: reservation_code: 'R-C2' -> None

name: InvalidAccessClearsParcel
description: INVALID_ACCESS in OCCUPIED erases the retrieval code.
example_killing_sequence: RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] retrieval_code: expected 'P-C1', actual None | [invariant_violation] I3 OCCUPIED needs retrieval_code == P-<customer>, got None | [reject_mutated_state] rejected op changed SUT state: retrieval_code: 'P-C1' -> None

name: RejectedReserveOverwritesCustomer
description: A rejected RESERVE in RESERVED still overwrites the customer ID (only observable when the new ID differs).
example_killing_sequence: RETRIEVE(code='') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE ; ENABLE ; RESERVE(C1) ; RESERVE(C2) ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='') ; RESERVE(C2) ; DEPOSIT(code='WRONG')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] customer_id: expected 'C1', actual 'C2' | [invariant_violation] I2 RESERVED needs reservation_code == R-<customer>, got 'R-C1' | [reject_mutated_state] rejected op changed SUT state: customer_id: 'C1' -> 'C2'

name: WrongRetrievalPrefix
description: Retrieval code is issued as R-<id> instead of P-<id>.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; EXPIRE(expired=False) ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; ENABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] retrieval_code: expected 'P-C1', actual 'R-C1' | [invariant_violation] I3 OCCUPIED needs retrieval_code == P-<customer>, got 'R-C1'

name: PrefixCodeMatchOnDeposit
description: DEPOSIT accepts any code that starts with the correct reservation code.
note: Only observable with a near-miss credential such as 'R-C1x'; run with --near-miss to add that input class.

name: DoubleCancelWhileOccupiedWipesCode
description: Two consecutive rejected CANCELs on an OCCUPIED locker wipe the retrieval code.
example_killing_sequence: EXPIRE(expired=False) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; RETRIEVE(code='WRONG') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; INVALID_ACCESS(code='INVALID') ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; RESERVE(C2) ; DEPOSIT(code='WRONG') ; DISABLE ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C2') ; CANCEL ; CANCEL ; DISABLE ; DISABLE
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] retrieval_code: expected 'P-C2', actual None | [invariant_violation] I3 OCCUPIED needs retrieval_code == P-<customer>, got None | [reject_mutated_state] rejected op changed SUT state: retrieval_code: 'P-C2' -> None
note: Triggered by the transition pair CANCEL[not_reserved] -> CANCEL[not_reserved] in OCCUPIED. Added to probe pair-based testing (see threats to validity).

name: DisableAfterRetrieveKeepsCustomer
description: DISABLE immediately after a successful RETRIEVE leaves a stale customer ID.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C2) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C2') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C2') ; DISABLE ; ENABLE ; DEPOSIT(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C2)
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] customer_id: expected None, actual 'STALE' | [invariant_violation] I1 MAINTENANCE must hold no customer/credential data, got 'STALE'/None/None
note: Triggered by the pair RETRIEVE[retrieved] -> DISABLE[disabled].

name: ThirdCycleStaleCode
description: The retrieval code is retained after the 3rd successful retrieval in a run.
example_killing_sequence: RESERVE(C1) ; ENABLE ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RESERVE(C2) ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C2) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; RESERVE(C1) ; CANCEL ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; EXPIRE(expired=True) ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; DISABLE ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1')
observed_incorrect_behaviour: [state_mismatch] retrieval_code: expected None, actual 'P-C1' | [invariant_violation] I1 AVAILABLE must hold no customer/credential data, got None/None/'P-C1'
witness: RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1') ; RESERVE(C1) ; DEPOSIT(code='R-C1') ; RETRIEVE(code='P-C1')
note: Needs 3 complete delivery cycles (>= 9 valid steps): beyond length-2 history, so transition-pair coverage does not guarantee exposing it.

name: EnableRedundantClear
description: ENABLE additionally clears data that is already empty.

name: DepositRedundantReassign
description: DEPOSIT re-assigns the reservation code to its existing value.
